label: Start Here
title: Welcome to Full-Stack Web Development
content: In modern software development, a full-stack engineer connects a rich, reactive client interface (React & Tailwind CSS) to a resilient, high-performance server runtime (Node.js). In this hands-on lesson, you will master the end-to-end flow: designing an interactive UI component, styling it with utility-first CSS, and handling backend API logic.

label: Learning Objectives
title: What You Will Master
objectives: Understand how client state triggers dynamic re-renders in React 19.
Apply Tailwind CSS utilities for responsive layouts, typography, and hover micro-interactions.
Write and execute backend data processing logic in Node.js via Piston.
Pass automated in-browser DOM and state interaction tests.

label: Core Concepts
title: Client-Server Architecture: The Separation of Concerns

subsections.heading: 1. The React Component Lifecycle & State
subsections.content: React components manage local state using the `useState` hook. Whenever state updates, React re-evaluates the component and patches the real browser DOM with minimal overhead.

subsections.heading: 2. Modern Utility Styling with Tailwind CSS
subsections.content: Rather than writing bespoke CSS classes, Tailwind gives you utility primitives like `flex`, `p-6`, `rounded-2xl`, and `shadow-xl`. This ensures design consistency and zero CSS bloat.

subsections.heading: 3. The Backend Data Pipeline in Node.js
subsections.content: On the server, Node.js processes asynchronous requests, validates payloads, and formats JSON responses before sending them back to the client.

title: Video Walkthrough: Full-Stack React & Node Architecture

label: Think About It
title: The Restaurant Dining Experience
content: Think of a full-stack web application like a fine dining restaurant. The dining room, table settings, and menu are the frontend (React & Tailwind)—designed to be intuitive, responsive, and visually delightful. The kitchen is the backend (Node.js & Piston)—handling heavy preparation, data storage, and order fulfillment away from the diners' sight.
example: When a customer orders a meal, the waiter (API call) takes the request to the kitchen (Node.js), and brings back a prepared dish (JSON response) for the customer to enjoy.

title: Backend Challenge: Process Order Total (Node.js / Piston)
content:
### Exercise Instructions
Complete the `calculateOrderTotal` function. It receives a `cart` array of items with `price` and `qty`. Calculate the subtotal, add 7.5% tax, and output exactly `Total: $<total>` (formatted to 2 decimal places with `.toFixed(2)`).

Click **Run Code** to execute your code on Piston and verify your answer against test cases.

title: Frontend Challenge: Interactive Course Card (React & Tailwind)
instructions:
### Task Instructions
1. Inspect the card container `#course-card`. It uses Tailwind utilities: `rounded-2xl`, `shadow-xl`, and `p-6`.
2. Update the main heading `h2` to display **'Full-Stack Mastery'**.
3. In `handleEnroll`, update the `enrolled` state so clicking `#enroll-btn` increments the student count.
4. Click **Run Tests & Grade** to run the in-browser test suite and submit your score!
5. You can also view logs in the **Console** tab or toggle **Full Screen** anytime.

tests.description: Card uses rounded-2xl, shadow-xl, and p-6 Tailwind classes

questions.content: Which hook in React is primarily used to declare and update reactive component state?
questions.explanation: useState() allows functional components to store state variables and triggers a re-render when the setter function is called.

questions.content: Why is Piston well-suited for backend code execution like Node.js or Python?
options: It provides a visual web browser window for rendering DOM elements
It compiles React JSX components into mobile apps
It provides an isolated, secure headless sandbox container for executing terminal scripts
It automatically publishes websites to production servers
questions.explanation: Piston is a headless execution sandbox designed to safely run scripts in containers and capture stdout/stderr.

questions.content: What is the primary benefit of using Tailwind CSS for UI development?
options: It enforces writing hundreds of lines of custom CSS files
It provides composable utility classes directly in JSX/HTML for rapid and consistent styling
It replaces JavaScript for backend API routes
It requires setting up a dedicated database
questions.explanation: Tailwind CSS provides utility classes like flex, rounded-2xl, and p-6 directly in markup, eliminating repetitive CSS stylesheets.

label: Quick Recap
title: Summary & Key Takeaways
items: Full-stack architecture pairs interactive React client components with secure Node.js server runtimes.
Tailwind CSS accelerates styling with utility classes directly in component markup.
The CODE_EXERCISE block executes backend code in real-time on Piston with live terminal stdout/stderr.
The FRONTEND_EXERCISE block renders live React and Tailwind UI via Sandpack with automated in-browser test grading.
